quests.title: Keeper Julio - Recover Julio's Storage Key (Key Quest 2 Sub-Quest)

quests.title: Tombeth Boss Awakening Chain (Waking Dream -> Dread Slumber -> Rude Awakening -> Trident Maze)
quests.chapter: Caballa Relics - General, Card Girl, Monster, Daily, 2nd Job & Boss Tombeth
quests.npc: Rosemary, Explorer Reina, Fortune Teller, Guide Sabrina, Keeper Julio & Indiana John
quests.location: Caballa Relics Dungeon 3 -> Boss Paths 1-3 -> The Trident Maze
steps: Step 1 (Rosemary, Relics Dungeon 3): Give 1x 500 Galder Coupon to teleport to Caballa Relics Boss Path 1 - Waking Dream.
Step 2 (Explorer Reina 1st, Waking Dream): Hunt 6x Guard Stone Soldier (Lv.60) in 1 min, then drill 1x Torn Clue 1 (40~60m, Rock) -> 1x Decoded Clue 1.
Step 3 (Explorer Reina 2nd, Waking Dream): Hunt 30x Awakened Guiana (Lv.70) in 10 min, then drill 1x Torn Clue 2 (40~60m, Rock) -> 1x Decoded Clue 2.
Step 4 (Fortune Teller, hidden southwest passage in Waking Dream): Hunt Awoken Mimic (Lv.65) for 5x Philosopher's Stone (500 weight each!) -> 1x Complete Decoded Doc.

Step 5 (Dread Slumber Rooms 1-16): Use Brick Guide Stones (+1 room) with Guide Sabrina or Chaotic + Fractal Guide Stones (+4 rooms) with Keeper Julio to reach Room 16 and enter Boss Path 3 - Rude Awakening.
Step 6 (Indiana John, Rude Awakening): Hunt 2x Tombeth's Soul (Lv.100) in 5 min to enter The Trident Maze, then speak to Guide Sabrina to enter Boss Tombeth's Room (Lv.121)!
